system.description:
FOLKWARDEN UTILITY WARDING
Folkwarden Specialist Spell
Cast 3 AP (material, somatic, verbal)
Range 30 feet
Area 20-foot radius centred upon a fixed point
Duration 1 minute

You invoke one of the oldest principles of folk protection: that a boundary deliberately established and properly witnessed possesses meaning.
A visible or symbolic boundary appears around the affected area: scattered salt, roots pushing through cracks, pale chalk marks, hanging threads, thorn shadows or another manifestation appropriate to your tradition.
Willing creatures within the area gain a +2-status bonus to saving throws against:
Curse effects;
Fear;
Mental effects;
possession;
Soul Drain; and
effects with the Soul trait.
In addition, whenever a hostile Undead creature, disembodied spirit, possessing entity or creature with the Incorporeal trait attempts to cross the boundary from outside, it must attempt a Will saving throw.
A creature attempts this save only the first time it tries to cross during each round.
Critical The creature crosses normally.
Success The creature crosses the boundary, but the first square it enters within the area counts as difficult terrain.
Failure The creature cannot cross the boundary during the current turn. Movement spent reaching the boundary is still expended.
Fumble The creature cannot voluntarily cross the boundary for the remainder of the spell.
A creature already inside the area when Old Law of the Threshold is cast is not expelled and may leave normally. If it later attempts to re-enter, it must attempt the saving throw.
The spell does not prevent ranged attacks, spells or abilities from crossing the boundary and does not obstruct ordinary living creatures merely because they are hostile.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Increase the radius by 10 feet.
+2 PP: Increase the duration to 10 minutes.
+3 PP: Increase the duration to 1 hour.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10. The +2 status is a scoped row on willing creatures inside; a hostile Undead, spirit or incorporeal creature crossing in rolls the Will save, and Failure or Fumble puts it back outside.
